stages_and_data_gate.cache_precondition: Both stages require the actual merged paired_cache_gate.json status PASS, all_non_future_arrays_exact true and exactly902TRAIN/128validation jobs. The already-reviewed merger writes this final gate only after validating all16input shards and writing/reloading all4merged roots. stages_and_data_gate.m0: Three epochs at batch384; torch.randperm(...).split(384) keeps the134-row final batch, hence3updates/epoch and9optimizer updates. M0 ends after trainer completion and writes its job marker; it contains no evaluator or call to full stage.
stages_and_data_gate.full_precondition: Full stage additionally requires future_policy_fit_m0_acceptance_20261004.json status PASS, both_teacher_arms_passed true, batch_size384 and optimizer_steps_per_arm9. This is the planned manual two-arm acceptance, not an automatically manufactured success flag. A missing/failed/single-arm acceptance cannot pass the script's condition.

training_api_and_single_factor.fresh_initialization: Trainer seeds torch/CUDA, constructs RecoverabilityModules from the frozen C1 checkpoint and has no resume/prefix-model load argument. The fixed own4 checkpoint is used by the already-collected prefixes/teachers, not loaded as initial student weights. C1 is strict-loaded, eval/frozen and excluded from optimizer parameters; model.train preserves C1 eval mode.
training_api_and_single_factor.objective_scope: All passed flags exist in the current parser. Omitting write-pair-calibration correctly leaves it false. Both teacher arms otherwise use identical source, batch/epoch/update budget, seed, optimizer defaults, action search/write modes and matched query inputs. The treatment changes the frozen future labels and the resulting same-form validation target, as planned.
training_api_and_single_factor.current_trainer_checks: Before updates, choices must reproduce C1 and no extra search may trigger. Training requires finite losses/gradients, no C1 gradients, positive A/B/C gradient norms and changed trained A/B/C groups. Best checkpoint is strict-reloaded and its validation metrics must exactly reproduce before completed receipt is written.
training_api_and_single_factor.best_zero_boundary: Best checkpoint selection uses strict held-out utility improvement and may legitimately retain epoch0. The A/B/C changed receipt concerns the trained trajectory before reloading best, not a promise that selected best has moved. Report the actual selected epoch and behavior.

manual_m0_acceptance_expectations: Read both actual c1/own M0 completion/config/train records:902TRAIN/128validation, batch384,3epochs,9updates, intended flags and finite losses/gradients.
Verify actual A/B/C gradient/update receipts, frozen C1 state/gradients, strict reload equality and usable selected checkpoint in both arms; record selected epoch even if0.
Write the two-arm fit acceptance only after both real M0s pass. This review is not that runtime acceptance and does not itself permit an early full run.
